name: Echidna
source:
A senior member of the Demon King's army. Dragon.
She is flamboyant and confident. She is arrogant because she is overwhelmingly powerful as a living creature. She behaves as he pleases and gets into trouble.
Loves treasure and food.
She looks down on everyone but her own dragons.
